ctx.x: Sidney De Paris the trumpet player and the Wilbur De Paris the trombone player.

Yeah. They come out of Indiana. And their mother and father had a show that used to be on side shows. They called that the midway, the show that you'd... The (?) little tab show. But they kept this little show together. And that's where... Jelly Roll's old lady, Mabel, was on the show. And the old man was Diamond Toot Willie... Diamond Toot Willie Arnkey(?)... Jimmy Arnkey(?)... Jimmy Arnkey was an actor and dancer that had a big diamond in his tooth, and when he went to Chicago with Mabel, Jelly Roll took Mabel
